decision_conditions: The proposal fails to provide adequate information to show that it would fall within class C3(b) which covers up to six people living together as a single household, including where care is provided for residents.   Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate that the occupants would form a single household engaging in a range of communal activities; the number of occupants plus carers would likely exceed six; the exact age range,  level of needs of the occupants has not been provided including details of the exact level of care / number of carers.  It is noted that no supporting statement have been submitted as part of this application.
Consequently the proposal fails to demonstrate the lawfulness of the use proposed and a Certificate cannot be issued.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for proposed change of use from Use Class C3(a) (dwelling house) to Use Class C(b) (supported living)
